rationale: A wins because it stays more disciplined about what is known and what would get a founder hurt. Its strongest line, "$3B in sales, a $5B valuation, and an undisclosed take-rate: the math under Whatnot's milestone," gives a real money-story spine without pretending GMV is revenue; B's version, "worth less than one times revenue it doesn't keep," is punchier but mathematically sloppy because the update never says revenue and the whole point is that Whatnot keeps only a commission. B has sharp instincts, especially on seller earnings, but it decorates the facts with "YouTube, Etsy, TikTok Shop, and Substack" and a Western live-shopping failure narrative the update did not supply. A is the cleaner strategist's document: fewer invented pegs, tighter warnings, better refusal discipline.
gaps_in_A: "$3B in annual sales is the first US-scale data point big enough to test that thesis" overreaches. The update gives a company-stated number, not proof that it is the first or uniquely big enough in the US market.
"Whatnot grew to $3B on trading cards" is too absolute. The facts say the platform started with trading cards and collectibles, not that the full $3B came from them.
The trend angle could use the same skepticism B applies to the Asia comparison; A asks for comparison data, but still lets the framing carry more weight than the supplied facts earn.
gaps_in_B: "The $3B figure is gross merchandise volume" is an assumption. The update says annual livestream-commerce sales and explicitly leaves the GMV-versus-revenue question unresolved.
"worth less than one times revenue it doesn't keep" is the set's worst line: it confuses valuation math by calling the denominator revenue while arguing it is not revenue.
"the beat that has run the same audit on YouTube, Etsy, TikTok Shop, and Substack" invents coverage history and named comparables not supplied in the update.
"the shutdown-and-retreat cycle of Western live-shopping efforts" may be true in the world, but it is not in the provided facts; for this blind task, that is a fake peg with a nice suit on.
